# Field types

The `type` of each field in a schema JSON. Some types only exist when the providing package is extended.

| Type | Aliases | Provided by | SQLite column | TypeScript | Form component | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `string` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT` | `string` | `UInput` | Short text (TEXT column) |
| `text` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT` | `string` | `UTextarea` | Long text content |
| `number` | `integer` | crouton-core | `INTEGER` | `number` | `UInputNumber` | Integer value |
| `decimal` |  | crouton-core | `REAL` | `number` | `UInputNumber` | Decimal number (10,2) |
| `boolean` |  | crouton-core | `INTEGER (boolean)` | `boolean` | `UCheckbox` | True/false toggle |
| `date` | `datetime` | crouton-core | `INTEGER (timestamp)` | `Date \| null` | `CroutonCalendar` | Date/timestamp |
| `json` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT (JSON)` | `Record<string, any>` | `UTextarea` | JSON object |
| `repeater` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT (JSON)` | `any[]` | `CroutonFormRepeater` | Repeatable items array |
| `array` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT (JSON)` | `string[]` | `UTextarea` | String array |
| `reference` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT` | `string` | `CroutonFormReferenceSelect` | Reference to another collection |
| `image` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT` | `string` | `CroutonImageUpload` | Image upload |
| `file` |  | crouton-core | `TEXT` | `string` | `CroutonImageUpload` | File upload |
| `richText` |  | crouton-editor | `TEXT` | `string` | `CroutonEditorSimple` | Rich text content (TipTap editor, translatable) |

## Allowed `meta` keys

Any other key on a field's `meta` is rejected at generate time.

- `required`
- `nullable`
- `unique`
- `default`
- `maxLength`
- `precision`
- `scale`
- `min`
- `max`
- `area`
- `group`
- `label`
- `description`
- `help`
- `readOnly`
- `sortable`
- `component`
- `displayAs`
- `picker`
- `url`
- `options`
- `optionsCollection`
- `optionsField`
- `optionsValueField`
- `optionsLabelField`
- `labelField`
- `creatable`
- `dependsOn`
- `dependsOnCollection`
- `dependsOnField`
- `translatable`
- `translatableProperties`
- `properties`
- `addLabel`
- `repeaterComponent`
